title: Home-Site Lease Lot Classes: Home Eligibility Limits
content:
Every Home-Site Lease site belongs to one lot class, and each lot class admits only a home that meets all three of its limits: the section type of the home, its overall length and its model year. The limits are read from the home's title or data plate.

| Lot class | Section type of the home | Overall length | Model year |
|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Single-Section Home Site | single-section | not more than 72 feet | 2006 or later |
| Preferred Single-Section Home Site | single-section | not more than 80 feet | 2006 or later |
| Standard Multi-Section Home Site | multi-section | not more than 68 feet | 2006 or later |
| Preferred Multi-Section Home Site | multi-section | not more than 76 feet | 2006 or later |
| Greenbelt Multi-Section Home Site | multi-section | not more than 76 feet | 2011 or later |
| Lakefront Multi-Section Home Site | multi-section | not more than 80 feet | 2016 or later |

A length limit is a maximum and a model-year limit is a minimum: a home exactly at the stated length, or of exactly the stated model year, is within the limit.

### Reading the table (hypothetical homes)

| Home on its data plate | Lot classes whose limits it meets |
|---|---|
| single-section, 72 feet, model year 2006 | Standard Single-Section and Preferred Single-Section |
| single-section, 74 feet, model year 2010 | Preferred Single-Section only (74 feet exceeds the 72-foot limit) |
| multi-section, 70 feet, model year 2012 | Preferred Multi-Section and Greenbelt Multi-Section (not Standard Multi-Section, as 70 feet exceeds 68; not Lakefront Multi-Section, as 2012 is earlier than 2016) |
| multi-section, 76 feet, model year 2009 | Preferred Multi-Section only (Greenbelt requires 2011 or later) |

A single-section home never meets a multi-section lot class, and a multi-section home never meets a single-section lot class, whatever its length or model year.
